scope: Read-only source review; production device helper not executed
checked: Fixed production /dev/mmcblk0 with 179:0 and exact CID; separate compile-time loop fixture
O_RDONLY/O_NOFOLLOW device open, root checks, full exact primary+backup GPT byte validation
Exact disk/logical-sector geometry, all existing partition 1-10 sysfs ranges, no unexpected partitions
64-bit positive aligned p11 byte start/length with overflow/end-of-disk constraints
Exact existing p11 is a no-op; otherwise sole mutation is BLKPG_ADD_PARTITION for p11
Identity/geometry/GPT/partition checks repeated before and after ADD; no DEL/BLKRRPART/GPT write
Advisory lock explicitly does not claim serialization against unrelated firmware writers
limitations: Kernel 4.19 BLKPG_ADD_PARTITION with NULL partition_meta_info does not create PARTUUID/PARTNAME until full GPT scan/reboot. Use verified sysfs start/size/dev and filesystem UUID for immediate consumers.
Source review does not prove hardware eMMC behavior, power-loss transaction safety, or firmware concurrent writer exclusion.
